strings.en: Tch...! It can't hold out any longer...!
Oh dear...@How uncool of me, honestly!
Taken down in a place like this...@I'm still so green...!
I leave the rest to you...
To think someone could force me back...!!
Tch!! What an early curtain call!
Th-This is as far as I go...!
Ngh! So this is my limit...!
I'm ejecting, I am...@Ngh...! I can't even go out with dignity...
Damn it!@You won't get me next time!
Kyah! I leave the rest to you!
Me, screwing up in a place like this...?!@This is no fun...
So I, too, still have much to learn...!
A-All hands!@Abandoning ship is top priority...!!
Dammit! Is this all I've got...?!
That was careless of me...@I'll pull back for now...!
Is this... as far as I go...?
Oh, no way! This is as far as I go!!
At my current skill...@this is as far as I go...!
Ngh... Me, made a shooting star...@I'm ejecting!
Ngggh! Not in a place like this!!
N-Not in a place like this...!
Sorry!@I'm gonna have to bow out...!
For the Granzon... to be shot down...
Damn it, is this as far as I go?!
I have no choice but to eject...!
Aw, man, they got me good!
Earth Federation Army Southern Europe Army -@Aviano Base
We just got a report from Lefina's detachment.@They also ran into <Dark Brain> remnants@leading <Lamaris>.
...I doubt it was Crystal Dragoon.@Which was it, Skull Knight or Debudedabide?
First, the former appeared at Hindan Base, where@the Hiryu Custom was resupplying. The latter showed@up at Karachi after that.
Skull Knight apparently tried to tie down Lefina's@detachment, but failed...
Later, when the Hiryu Custom went to Karachi,@a Lamaris Kaana appeared and was captured@by Debudedabide.
So the Lamaris Kaana was what they were really after.
Did a Kaana type appear at Hindan?
No. Most likely because, like Aviano,@it isn't a densely populated area.
And from this series of incidents,@we can draw several inferences.
First, they can capture the Lamaris and control them@to some degree, but they likely didn't understand@the conditions under which Kaana types appear.
Still, judging by past events, they suspected some@factor in the <Steel Dragons>, so Skull Knight and@Crystal Dragoon put that to the test.
So that's why they threw@the Lamaris at us.
Even so, the battle at Karachi must have given them@a clue. Lefina's detachment drove off Debudedabide,@but if they still intend to capture Kaana types...
You mean they might show up in Paris.
With <Ariard> aboard the Hagane,@I figured there was a good chance@we'd be attacked by Gadisword, but...
I guess we should just be glad@Lefina's detachment is drawing@the Fury's attention.
I see, so Sieg and Sally are aboard this ship...
Lieutenant Saika,@those two will be treated the same as Fairy, right?
(In other words, like me and <Ariard>,@they'll be used as decoys to draw@Gadisword's attention...)
(Is the Earth government trying to buy time,@or does it have no intention of reopening@peace talks...?)
(Either way, if I want to learn the truth@Herluga and the others have hidden,@I'm better off aboard this ship.)
(The <Steel Dragons> may end up@going to <Rabulpaila> someday...)
What's the deal between Sally and Sieg?
No, I'm just a little curious, that's all.@I was wondering if Sally and Sieg@are really brother and sister.
They're childhood friends. With my brother and me, too.@We all lived in the same town on <Anex>.
Sally became a soldier too, following Sieg and Fio@into the army. It was a coincidence that the four@of us met again on <Rabulpaila>, though...
Sieg and Sally are both good kids.@So please be nice to them.
That might be what it takes to improve relations@between Gadisword and Earth...
Yeah. You too, Fairy, but people from Gadisword@don't feel like aliens to me. That's why I think@there's a way to avoid this war.
I don't know how much I can do,@but if I can help you and your people...
...It's almost time for the briefing.@Let's go, Akimi.
Yeah. First we gotta sort out the mess on Earth.
In French, it means a triumphal return.
It means coming home victorious from war, I do declare.
I guess it means defeating the Lamaris occupying Paris@so the people who evacuated can come home.
I really want to get the old Paris back as soon as@possible. I hope the Louvre and the Musee d'Orsay@are all right.
Yes, visiting art museums is my hobby.
Then once this fight's over and we get some leave,@why don't we go together? I know a great place@to eat near the Orsay, too.
You seem to know Paris pretty well.
Yes. I lived there once because of my father's work.@The Champs-Elysees, the Place Charles de Gaulle...@I have lots of memories of the City of Flowers.
The Flower City, huh? Endless Frontier@has a pretty special flower city of its own.
Then we'll begin the briefing for@Operation Triumph. Major Kai, the overview.
Sir.@This operation aims to annihilate the Lamaris@occupying all of Paris with concentrated fire.
First, in the First Phase, we'll build@a tight encirclement around central Paris.
In the Second Phase, each mobile unit will attack@to drive the Lamaris swarm into one spot...
In the Final Phase, we, the Steel Dragons, wipe them@out and cleanse Paris. At the core of that will be@the SRX Team and the PTX Team, but...
If luring the Lamaris is delayed in the Second Phase,@we may have both teams' T-LINK System units@act as a diversion.
Also, the Final Phase battle zone is@the Place Charles de Gaulle... right in front of@the Arc de Triomphe.
And if a Lamaris Kaana appears, Dark Brain's@remnants may enter the battle zone after it.@Keep that in mind.
This operation to retake the Federation's capital@puts the Earth Federation Army's prestige on the line.@Failure is not an option. All hands, fight hard.
...So we corner the Lamaris and take 'em all out@in one sweep. Time for the SRX Team to shine.
Don't get carried away and break@the Arc de Triomphe, okay?
(If that happened, our names would go down@in history. I'd better be careful too.)
...If I had the Saber Booster,@I wouldn't be stuck moving around@these cramped streets.
There's no point wishing for what you don't have.
But c'mon, almost every other unit can fly.
There are things only ground units can do.@Let's each do the job we've been given.
Touma's right.@The Steel Dragons are at half strength,@so we have to try harder than ever.
This time, us on the SRX Team@have a lot on our plate.@Back us up, Akimi.
Don't falter! Push the Lamaris into the center!!
New Lamaris appearing in the battle zone! Six of them!
How long since the seventh wave appeared?!
About ten minutes!@The cycle's getting even shorter!
Do those things understand that@this is the decisive battle...?!
There's that many of them just on the perimeter?
Reinforcements are the SRX and the ART-Wing@from the Steel Dragons!
So that's the Far East's pride and joy...!
Ryu, Mai, let's draw in the Lamaris.
Ryusei, I'll take over the controls.
Yeah, the No. 4 vernier's a little weak.@You have control.
Mai, connect connectors 1 through 10.@T-LINK full contact.
(Focusing my telekinesis...@C'mon, follow me, you Lamaris...!)
The Lamaris swarm is moving!@It's pursuing the SRX and the ART-Wing!
I thought that talk of them drawing in the Lamaris@was hogwash... but they react that strongly?
Message from operation HQ! Moving to@the Final Phase, 200 seconds behind schedule!
Attention, all units!@To ensure the operation's success, support the Steel@Dragons! Destroy as many Lamaris as you can!
What's the Lamaris swarm on the perimeter doing?
About 80 percent are moving toward this ship!
(I'd say the diversion was a success.)
120 seconds until the Final Phase begins!
This is it.@Captain, Marshal Gaspar is watching.@Failure will not be tolerated.
No matter whose eyes are on us, we can't leave Paris,@the Federation's capital, to be trampled by the Lamaris.
Quite right, but I'm telling you to rise to the occasion.
Captain, final check of the approach course complete.
Good... Deploy the energy field in all directions@at maximum output. Both engines ahead, third battle@speed. Charge to the skies over Place Charles de Gaulle.
Captain, we've reached the skies@over Place Charles de Gaulle.
<TD Hovering> at current altitude.@Deploy the energy field on the lower hemisphere.@Upper guns, prepare to fire. Launch all mobile units.
Oh no, the Arc de Triomphe and the Champs-Elysees...!
Looks like a street I've seen somewhere, all torn up.@It's a total ghost town.
The Lamaris swarm ahead is starting to fuse!
And look at those numbers...@The reaction seems stronger than at Jakarta.
The perimeter Lamaris swarm is entering@the battle zone!
There are fewer Lamaris than@when we ran the diversion...
Thanks to the allied units on the perimeter.
We're not fighting this alone...@That's why we can't lose here!
Now that a Kaana type has shown up,@there's a better chance Dark Brain's remnants@will barge in.
It's a race against time to see@if we can clean up the Lamaris@before they show up.
Eleve 1 to all units!@Wipe out the Lamaris and liberate Paris!
Spatial distortion detected overhead!@It closely matches the sign of Debudedabide's halo!
Bufufuu, looks like a big haul today.@Good, gooood.
Well, well, running into Big Fatty again.
If he had a bounty on him, I might get fired up,@but working for free against that? I got nothin'.
Just like at Karachi, it seems he can only@transport them one at a time.
Saves us a whole lotta trouble, it does.@Take it and go, you thief.
Eleve 1 to all units! Take out the Lamaris@and stop Debudedabide!
Bufu, that one's miiine!@Gimme your plate, gimme your grub,@Debudedabideboo!
Gufu, this is the last one!@Gimme your plate, gimme your grub,@Debudedabideboo!
My business here is done! Farewell!
Eleve 1 to all units!@Wipe out the remaining Lamaris!
The last Lamaris Kaana and@Debudedabide's signals are gone!
No signals anywhere in the Paris area!
...It leaves a bad taste, but it seems@the liberation of Paris succeeded for now.@Report that to Marshal Gaspar.
Roger. Reporting to the Joint Chiefs of Staff.
Graaah! Curse you for getting in my waaay!@You'll remember thiiis!
Hurry and mop up the remaining Lamaris.
OK, Wimpy Hunter.@Playtime is over. The End.
Confirmed: no enemy signals in the battle zone@or anywhere in the Paris area!
It seems the liberation of Paris succeeded for now.@Report that to Marshal Gaspar.
As long as we're here, we won't let you@capture any Kaana types!
Every last one of you says the same thiiing!@I'm sick of heariiing it!
Where he's transporting the Kaana types to is...!
Get in my way and I'll send you too-ooo!@Straight to the next wooorld!
I don't know what you're scheming,@but you won't get the Kaana types!
I'm practically helping you out heeere,@so quit getting in my waaay!
If you want those malice beings gone fast,@you'd better not get in my waaay!
Our objective is to annihilate the Lamaris.@It's not enough for them to just disappear from here.
I won't let you do as you please@with the city I have memories of!
That's got nothing to do with meee!@I'm taking those malice beings with meee!
What are you going to do with all those@Lamaris Kaana?!
Gufufuu, you fooool!@As if I'd tell you thaaat!
I can't let a looter like you get away!
You just shut up and waaatch!@Stop getting in my waaay!
The malice beings are miiine!@I won't let you have them!
You're not taking any more Kaana types.@We'll wipe out the rest ourselves!
Just as I thought. You can command the Lamaris,@but you can't activate them.
The Lamaris weren't enough, so now you want@Kaana types for your army too?!
I won't let you near the Kaana types!
Grrr, if I could transport them all at once,@you'd beee...!
If you're collecting Kaana types,@then we'll just stop you!
Flitting around like that, you're so annoyiiing!
What I'm saying is, there's no part for you@in this revue, mister.
Bufuu, you just shut up and waaatch!
Paris - Earth Federation Army Joint Staff HQ
Earth Federation Army Joint Staff HQ
Yes... Commanding from an outpost while my own@headquarters was taken taught me just how@unpleasant that is, but...
I'm glad to make this triumphant return.@Restoration of headquarters seems to be going well.
Any signs of the Lamaris reappearing?
Then please tell the President that@Operation Triumph was a success.
If Gadisword, the Golaikunru and the Fury make no@major moves, we'll move up the schedule and carry out@the operation to wipe out the Lamaris in Berlin.
The Steel Dragons have been worn down@by their recent string of battles, but...
If Dark Brain's remnants are moving in on@the Lamaris, we must act quickly.@I've no wish to watch the clowns' encore.
Then after gathering both Steel Dragons@detachments at Aviano, I'll send them to Berlin.
